```{r}
library(tradeSeq)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(slingshot)
```

```{r}
adata <- read_h5ad("2.5_car_no_gd.h5ad", as = "SingleCellExperiment")
sce <- readRDS("car_only/car_slingshot_object.rds")
counts_full <- assay(sce, "counts")
pt <- slingPseudotime(sce, na = FALSE)
cw <- slingCurveWeights(sce)
```

```{r}
lin <- c(1, 3)
pt_sub <- pt[, lin]
cw_sub <- cw[, lin]

keep_cells <- rowSums(cw_sub) > 0
counts_sub <- counts_full[, keep_cells]
pt_sub <- pt_sub[keep_cells, ]
cw_sub <- cw_sub[keep_cells, ]
```

```{r}
# keep genes detected in at least ~1% of cells
keep <- rowSums(counts_full > 0) >= 0.05 * ncol(counts_full)
sum(keep)

# always include your genes of interest
th2_genes <- c("GATA3", "STAT6", "STAT5A", "MAML1", "EP300", "RAD50", "IL4R", "NOTCH1", "NOTCH2", "TBX21", "IRF4", "BCL11B")
genes_use <- union(rownames(counts_full)[keep], th2_genes)
```

```{r}
set.seed(5)
library(BiocParallel)

cond <- factor(cell_df[colnames(counts_sub), "outcome"])

sce_fit <- fitGAM(
  counts      = counts_full,
  pseudotime  = pt,
  cellWeights = cw,
  #conditions = cond,
  genes       = th2_genes,   # or omit `genes` entirely to fit everything
  nknots      = 6,
  parallel    = TRUE,
  BPPARAM     = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(4)
)
saveRDS(sce_fit, "car_only/tradeseq_fit.rds")
```
